data.scope: 15 FD-014 public CLI black-box cases, one focused invocation
data.expected_duration: normally under 120 seconds; child process timeout 15 seconds
data.side_effects: Read the CLI entrypoint and FD template; create and remove Git, FD, receipt, report and archive fixtures only inside per-case temporary directories.
data.risk_review: Planner inspected the test file, temporary Git setup, CLI dispatch and close paths. The command is offline, inspectable and confined to temporary files. It does not request secrets, network, dependency downloads, privilege changes, unrelated writes or final artifacts.
